CLIP (with atom IDs): E07.015 | 00:30.00-00:35.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on Corin as the lamp flickers behind them.
E07.016 | 00:30.40-00:33.44 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (pompous, cold) | "Order! I will have order in my hall!"
E07.017 | 00:35.00-00:41.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E07.018 | 00:41.00-00:45.00 | CAM | High wide shot of the crowded hall turning toward the door.
E07.019 | 00:41.40-00:44.44 | DLG | CORIN (earnest, protective) | "The ring smells of your rose oil, Selene."
E07.020 | 00:45.00-00:51.00 | CAM | Medium two-shot of Selene and the Mayor, the space between them charged.
E07.021 | 00:45.40-00:48.44 | DLG | CORIN (O.S., protective, low) | "The ring smells of your rose oil, Selene."
E07.022 | 00:51.00-00:56.00 | CAM | Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.
E07.023 | 00:54.50-00:56.00 | SFX | A heartbeat pulse rises toward the cliffhanger.
E07.024 | 00:56.00-00:59.00 | CAM | Low angle on Selene framed against the lighthouse beam.
E07.025 | 00:56.40-00:58.80 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (cold, silken) | "Expose me and her father hangs beside me."
E07.026 | 00:59.00-01:04.00 | CAM | Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.
E07.027 | 00:59.40-01:02.82 | DLG | SELENE (cruel, mocking) | "Smile, sister. It is your last night of freedom."
KEY REVEALS OF THE SHOW: R01 (E1): [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her
R02 (E2): [mock] The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain
R03 (E3): [mock] On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family
R04 (E4): [mock] Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship
R05 (E5): [mock] Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast
R06 (E6): [mock] The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara
R07 (E7): [mock] Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant
R08 (E8): [mock] Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room
